name: ShopGlut – Store Builder for WooCommerce
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
ShopGlut – Builder and Customized Solutions for WooCommerce is the ultimate all-in-one solution for creating stunning WooCommerce stores. This comprehensive plugin transforms your entire WooCommerce experience with professional layouts and enhanced customer engagement features.

🔥 FIVE POWERFUL MODULES IN ONE PLUGIN

⚡ Single Product Page Builder – Create stunning, conversion-optimized product pages with drag-and-drop interface
🛒 Cart Page Builder – Design custom cart experiences with responsive layouts and interactive elements
📝 Checkout Field Editor – Add, customize, and manage checkout fields for both classic and block checkout
💝 Advanced Wishlist System – Complete wishlist solution with social sharing, notifications, and guest support
🎨 Product Swatches – Replace dropdowns with beautiful color, image, and label swatches for variations

🚀 Why Choose ShopGlut?

Transform your entire WooCommerce store from product pages to cart and checkout with our comprehensive suite of tools. Create conversion-optimized product pages, streamlined cart experiences, customized checkout forms, and advanced wishlist functionality that encourages return visits and increases sales. Our plugin offers unprecedented control over every aspect of your store design and customer journey.

🎨 COMPLETE WOOCOMMERCE STORE BUILDER SUITE

⭐ Key Benefits:
✅ Zero Coding Required – Visual sorting interface for everyone
✅ Mobile Responsive – Perfect on all devices automatically
✅ Lightning Fast – Performance-optimized for speed
✅ SEO Friendly – Built-in schema markup and optimization
✅ Theme Compatible – Works with any WordPress theme
✅ Complete Solution – Single product builder + Advanced wishlist in one plugin

🎨 SINGLE PRODUCT PAGE BUILDER

Intuitive Design Interface:
* Live Preview Demo Mode – See changes instantly as you design with real-time preview
* Product Targeting System – Overwrite all products or target specific products individually
* Template1 Configuration – Professional single product template with advanced customization
* Tabbed Settings Interface – Organized settings for Product Gallery, Info, Attributes, Purchase, Features, and Related Products
* Visual Column Builder – Create custom layouts with flexible columns
* Responsive Controls – Perfect design for mobile, tablet, and desktop

Advanced Product Gallery System:
* Main Image Controls – Customizable background, border radius, padding, and margin settings
* Thumbnail Gallery Management – Show/hide thumbnails with size, spacing, and alignment controls
* Border Customization – Independent border settings for main image and thumbnails
* Active State Styling – Custom border colors for active and hover thumbnail states
* Flexible Positioning – Left, center, or right thumbnail alignment options
* Advanced Spacing Controls – Precise margin and gap controls between gallery elements

📱 FLEXIBLE LAYOUT OPTIONS

Multiple Layout Types:
* Two Column – Classic gallery + info layout with customizable ratios
* Sidebar Layouts – Add promotional content and related products
* Mobile-First Design – Automatic mobile optimization with custom breakpoints

Column Customization:
* Custom Spacing – Control gaps between columns and sections
* Background Colors – Individual background colors for each column
* Padding Controls – Fine-tune spacing inside columns

🎨 ADVANCED PRODUCT SWATCHES SYSTEM

Comprehensive Swatch Types:
* Color Swatches – Display product variations with color swatches instead of dropdown selects
* Image Swatches – Show product variations with image thumbnails for better visual representation
* Bicolor Swatches – Advanced dual-color swatches for complex color combinations
* Label Swatches – Text-based swatches with custom styling and typography
* Mixed Attribute Types – Support for multiple swatch types within the same product

Global Swatch Management:
* Attribute-Level Control – Set swatch types globally for product attributes (color, size, material, etc.)
* Product-Level Override – Override global settings for individual products
* Term-Specific Customization – Customize individual attribute terms with specific colors, images, or labels
* Taxonomy Integration – Seamless integration with WooCommerce attribute taxonomies

Advanced Swatch Features:
* Shop Page Integration – Display swatches on shop, category, and archive pages
* Quick Selection – Allow customers to select variations directly from shop pages
* Tooltip Support – Show attribute names and details on hover
* Image Preview Tooltips – Display larger preview images for image swatches (Pro)
* Custom Positioning – Position swatches before/after title or price on shop pages
* Attribute Limiting – Limit number of swatches shown on shop pages with “more” links

Swatch Styling Options:
* Shape Controls – Circle, square, rounded, or custom dimensions
* Size Customization – Individual width and height controls for each attribute
* Border Options – Custom borders, colors, and hover effects for selected states
* Border Radius – Rounded corners with pixel-perfect control
* Typography – Font size and styling for label-type swatches
* Spacing Controls – Margin and padding adjustments for perfect alignment

Smart Swatch Behavior:
* Stock Integration – Hide or disable swatches for out-of-stock variations
* Disabled State Effects – Blur, cross-out, or hide unavailable options
* AJAX Loading – Fast, smooth swatch interactions without page reloads
* Variation Threshold – Automatic optimization for products with many variations
* Mobile Responsive – Touch-friendly swatches optimized for mobile devices

🏷️ ADVANCED PRODUCT BADGE SYSTEM

Comprehensive Badge Management:
* Six Badge Types – New, Trending, Best Seller, Hot, Sale, Limited with individual control
* Custom Badge Text – Personalize badge text for each type
* Color Customization – Independent background and text colors for each badge
* Typography Controls – Font size, weight, and spacing customization
* Global Badge Settings – Border radius, spacing, and show/hide controls
* Dynamic Badge Logic – Badges display based on product conditions and sales data

Product Information Display:
* Product Title Styling – Color, font size, and weight customization
* Rating System – Show/hide ratings with star color and text styling controls
* Price Display Controls – Current price, original price, and discount badge styling
* Description Management – Show/hide with color, font size, and line height controls
* Advanced Typography – Precise control over all text elements

Interactive Product Attributes:
* Multiple Attribute Layouts – Horizontal, vertical, and grid layout options
* Swatch Attributes – Color swatches, patterns, and image attributes with size and border controls
* Button Attributes – Text/size options displayed as styled buttons with hover effects
* Dropdown Attributes – Traditional select dropdown styling and customization
* Label Management – Show/hide attribute labels with typography controls
* Required Field Indicators – Visual asterisk styling for required attributes

🛒 ENHANCED PURCHASE SECTION

Quantity Selector Customization:
* Button Styling – Background and text color controls for plus/minus buttons
* Input Field Design – Custom background and border colors for quantity input
* Border Radius Control – Rounded corners for modern appearance
* Interactive States – Hover and focus styling for better user experience

Add to Cart Button Enhancement:
* Color Customization – Background, text, and hover color controls
* Typography Settings – Font size and weight customization
* Border Radius – Modern button styling with adjustable corners
* Button States – Active and hover state styling
* Variable Product Support – Enhanced AJAX handling for variable products

Secondary Action Buttons:
* Wishlist Integration – Show/hide wishlist button with custom styling
* Compare Functionality – Product comparison button with color controls
* Button Positioning – Flexible positioning relative to main purchase button
* Hover Effects – Custom hover colors and transitions

⭐ DYNAMIC FEATURES SECTION

Features Section Management:
* Show/Hide Control – Enable or disable the entire features section
* Custom Section Title – Personalize the features section heading
* Background Styling – Custom background colors and border radius
* Grid Layout System – Choose from 1-6 column grid layouts
* Spacing Controls – Padding and gap controls for perfect alignment

Dynamic Features List:
* Unlimited Features – Add up to 12 product features with repeater field
* Icon Options – Choose between Font Awesome icons or custom images
* Feature Titles – Custom titles for each feature with styling controls
* Feature Descriptions – Short descriptions explaining each benefit
* Optional Links – Enable links for features with target window options
* Default Features – Pre-configured features (Free Shipping, Easy Returns, Secure Payment, 24/7 Support)

Feature Styling Options:
* Alignment Control – Left, center, or right alignment for feature items
* Icon Customization – Size, color, and background controls for icons
* Typography Settings – Title and description font styling
* Link Styling – Link colors, hover effects, and decoration options
* Spacing Controls – Margins and padding for perfect layout balance

🔗 ENHANCED RELATED PRODUCTS

Related Products Section:
* Show/Hide Control – Enable or disable related products display
* Custom Section Title – Personalize the related products heading
* Products Per Row – Choose from 2, 3, or 4 products per row layout
* Section Title Styling – Custom colors and typography for section heading

Product Card Customization:
* Card Background – Custom background colors for product cards
* Border Styling – Border colors and radius for modern card design
* Hover Effects – Enable/disable card hover shadow effects
* Quick Add Buttons – Custom colors for quick add to cart buttons
* Typography Controls – Product name, price, and description styling

🛒 ADVANCED CART PAGE BUILDER

Complete Cart Page Customization:
* Visual Cart Layout Builder – Design custom cart pages with drag-and-drop interface
* Responsive Cart Tables – Mobile-optimized cart display with customizable columns
* Product Information Control – Show/hide product images, names, prices, quantities, and totals
* Interactive Elements – Custom quantity selectors, remove buttons, and continue shopping links
* Cross-sell Integration – Display recommended products and upsells in cart
* Progress Indicators – Shopping cart progress bars and checkout flow visualization
* Cart Totals Customization – Flexible subtotal, tax, shipping, and total displays

Cart Table Features:
* Customizable Headers – Configure table column headers and labels
* Product Image Settings – Control image sizes, aspect ratios, and display options
* Quantity Controls – Plus/minus buttons with validation and stock checking
* Product Meta Display – Show SKU, categories, attributes, and custom fields
* Badge System – Sale badges, stock status indicators, and promotional labels
* Action Buttons – Customizable remove, save for later, and move to wishlist buttons

Enhanced User Experience:
* AJAX Cart Updates – Real-time cart updates without page refresh
* Empty Cart States – Custom messages and call-to-action buttons for empty carts
* Cart Notifications – Success and error messages with custom styling
* Shipping Calculator – Integrated shipping cost estimation
* Coupon Code Interface – Streamlined discount code application
* Cart Recovery Features – Abandoned cart prevention and recovery tools

📝 CHECKOUT FIELD EDITOR

Complete Checkout Customization:
* Field Management System – Add, edit, remove, and reorder checkout fields
* Multiple Field Types – Text, email, phone, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, date, and more
* Section Organization – Manage billing, shipping, and additional information sections
* Advanced Validation – Email, phone, postcode, state, and number validation options
* Field Positioning – Drag-and-drop field reordering with priority controls
* Conditional Fields – Show/hide fields based on conditions and user selections

Classic Checkout Support:
* Billing Fields – Complete billing address field customization
* Shipping Fields – Flexible shipping information collection
* Additional Fields – Custom fields for order notes and special requirements
* Field Properties – Control labels, placeholders, CSS classes, and validation rules
* Required Field Settings – Mark fields as mandatory or optional
* Display Options – Choose where fields appear in emails and order details

WooCommerce Blocks Integration:
* Block Checkout Fields – Specialized fields for WooCommerce block-based checkout
* Contact Section – Custom contact information fields
* Address Section – Enhanced address field management
* Order Section – Special order-related custom fields
* Limited Field Types – Text, select, and checkbox support for blocks compatibility
* Modern Interface – Clean, modern field management interface

Advanced Features:
* Import/Export Settings – Backup and restore field configurations
* Locale Override – Override WooCommerce default locale settings
* Field Validation – Multiple validation rules for data integrity
* Order Integration – Display custom fields in admin orders and customer emails
* Database Storage – Secure storage of custom field values in order meta
* AJAX Administration – Real-time field management without page reloads

🛍️ COMPREHENSIVE WISHLIST SYSTEM

Core Wishlist Features:
* Guest User Support – Cookie-based wishlist storage with automatic login merging
* Social Sharing – Share wishlists on Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Telegram, Email
* Email Notifications – Stock alerts, price drops, and product updates for registered users
* Bulk Operations – Add all wishlist items to cart with one click
* Print Functionality – Customer-friendly wishlist printing
* AJAX Interactions – Smooth, fast user experience without page reloads

Smart Wishlist Management:
* Sortable Tables – Sort by date added, product name, price, availability
* Advanced Filtering – Filter by stock status, sale items, product categories
* Customizable Columns – Show/hide product data with column ordering
* Individual Product Tracking – Track exact date and time when each product was added
* Automatic Merging – Seamlessly merge guest wishlists when users login or register

Wishlist Display Options:
* Shortcode Support – Use [shopglut_wishlist] to display wishlist on any page
* Responsive Design – Mobile-optimized wishlist table and interface
* Table Customization – Show/hide columns for image, name, price, quantity, availability, etc.
* Multiple View Options – List view, grid view, compact view
* Bulk Selection – Checkbox selection for multiple items

🎛️ WISHLIST BUTTON CUSTOMIZATION

Button Positioning:
* Product Pages – Before/after add to cart button, after product meta
* Shop Pages – Integrated with product listings
* Archive Pages – Category and tag pages with filtering options

Button Styles:
* Text Only – Simple text-based wishlist buttons
* Icon Only – Icon-based buttons with Font Awesome support
* Text + Icon – Combined text and icon with flexible positioning
* Custom Styling – Unlimited color, size, and spacing customization

Advanced Button Settings:
* Custom Text – Configurable button text and “after added” text
* Icon Selection – Choose from hundreds of Font Awesome icons
* Click Actions – Remove from wishlist, go to wishlist page, show confirmation, redirect to checkout
* Hover Effects – Custom hover animations and color changes

🔔 ADVANCED NOTIFICATION SYSTEM

Email Notifications (Registered Users):

* Low Stock Warnings – Alert when products are running low on inventory
* Subscription Management – User-controlled notification preferences

* Custom Styling – Separate colors for “added” and “removed” notifications
* Custom Messages – Personalized notification text for different actions

Guest User Experience:
* Cookie-Based Storage – Reliable wishlist storage for non-logged users (30-day expiration)
* Cross-Session Persistence – Wishlist items persist across browser sessions
* Automatic Account Merging – Seamless wishlist transfer when guests register
* Privacy Compliant – GDPR-friendly cookie handling and data management

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):
1. Go to your WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
2. Search for “ShopGlut Builder and Customized Solutions”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
4. Navigate to ShopGlut → Single Product Builder to start designing
5. Go to ShopGlut → Wishlist Options to configure wishlist settings
6. Access Cart Page Builder, Checkout Field Editor, and Product Swatches from the ShopGlut menu

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file from WordPress.org
2. Upload via WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Or extract to /wp-content/plugins/shopglut/ directory
4. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
5. Access all five modules through the ShopGlut admin menu

Quick Setup Guide:

Setting Up the Single Product Page Builder:
1. Go to ShopGlut → Single Product Builder in your admin dashboard
2. Click “Create New Layout” to start with the visual builder
3. Choose your preferred layout type (single or two-column)
4. Sorting sections to customize your product page layout
5. Customize colors, fonts, and spacing to match your brand
6. Select which products to apply the layout to
7. Preview on mobile and desktop devices
8. Publish your enhanced product pages

Setting Up the Cart Page Builder:
1. Navigate to ShopGlut → Cart Page Builder
2. Create a new cart layout or edit an existing one
3. Customize the cart table:
– Configure column headers and labels
– Set product image sizes and styles
– Customize quantity controls and buttons
4. Configure cart totals section:
– Customize subtotal, tax, and total displays
– Add shipping calculator integration
– Set up coupon code interface
5. Style the cart page:
– Choose colors and typography
– Set spacing and layout options
– Configure mobile responsiveness
6. Apply the layout to your cart page and test functionality

Setting Up the Checkout Field Editor:
1. Go to ShopGlut → Checkout Field Editor
2. Choose between Classic Checkout Fields or Block Checkout Fields tabs
3. Manage existing fields:
– Edit field labels, placeholders, and requirements
– Reorder fields using drag-and-drop
– Enable/disable fields as needed
4. Add new custom fields:
– Select field type (text, email, select, checkbox, etc.)
– Set field properties and validation rules
– Choose display options for emails and orders
5. Configure advanced settings:
– Set up locale overrides
– Export field configurations for backup
– Import previously saved field settings
6. Test the checkout process with your custom fields

Setting Up the Wishlist System:
1. Navigate to ShopGlut → Wishlist Options
2. Configure general settings:
– Choose whether to require user login
– Select your dedicated wishlist page
– Set up notification preferences
3. Customize wishlist button appearance:
– Choose button style (text, icon, or both)
– Select button positioning on product pages
– Customize colors and hover effects
4. Configure wishlist page settings:
– Choose which columns to display
– Set up sorting and filtering options
– Customize table styling
5. Create a new page and add the shortcode [shopglut_wishlist]
6. Test the wishlist functionality on your store

Setting Up the Product Swatches System:
1. Navigate to ShopGlut → Product Swatches in your admin dashboard
2. Configure general settings:
– Enable ShopGlut Swatches for product pages
– Enable swatches for shop/archive pages
– Set up disabled attribute effects and tooltips
3. Customize global appearance:
– Set default swatch dimensions (width and height)
– Configure global border styles and radius
– Choose attribute label positioning (inline, stacked, or none)
– Set up tooltip colors and font sizes
4. Configure shop page settings:
– Choose swatch alignment (left, center, right)
– Set swatch position (before/after title or price)
– Enable chosen attributes mode to show specific attributes only
– Set attribute showing limits for shop pages
5. Set up attribute-specific swatches:
– Go to Products → Attributes to manage your product attributes
– Edit individual attributes to set swatch types (color, image, label, bicolor)
– Configure attribute-specific shapes and sizes
– Add colors, images, or labels to attribute terms
6. Customize product-level swatches (for variable products):
– Edit any variable product in your store
– Go to the “Swatches” tab in product data
– Override global settings for specific products
– Set custom swatches for individual product variations
7. Test swatches on your product and shop pages

System Requirements:
* WordPress 5.1+ (WordPress 6.0+ recommended)
* WooCommerce 3.0+ (latest version recommended)
* PHP 7.4+ (PHP 8.0+ recommended for better performance)
* MySQL 5.6+ or MariaDB 10.0+
* Memory limit: 128MB minimum (256MB+ recommended)
* Modern web browser with JavaScript enabled
sections.faq:
Is coding knowledge required to use this plugin?

No! Both the single product page builder and wishlist system are designed for users of all skill levels. The intuitive interface makes it easy to create professional product pages and configure advanced wishlist settings without any coding knowledge.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. ShopGlut is performance-optimized with conditional loading, efficient database queries, and modern caching techniques. The plugin only loads necessary scripts when needed, and most users actually see improved performance due to better code optimization compared to theme defaults.

Does the page builder work with all WooCommerce product types?

Absolutely! The plugin fully supports all WooCommerce product types including simple products, variable products (with attributes), grouped products, and external/affiliate products. Each product type has specialized layout options and form handling.

How do I customize my WooCommerce cart page?

Navigate to ShopGlut → Cart Page Builder in your admin dashboard. You can customize the cart table layout, product information display, quantity controls, and cart totals section. The visual builder allows you to see changes in real-time and create a mobile-responsive cart experience.

Can I add custom fields to the WooCommerce checkout?

Yes! Go to ShopGlut → Checkout Field Editor to add, edit, or remove checkout fields. You can create custom fields for billing, shipping, and additional information sections. The plugin supports both classic checkout and WooCommerce Blocks checkout with various field types including text, email, select, checkbox, and more.

How do I display the wishlist on my website?

Create a new page in WordPress and add the shortcode [shopglut_wishlist] where you want the wishlist to appear. You can also set this page as the default wishlist page in the plugin settings under ShopGlut → Wishlist Options.

Can guests use the wishlist without creating an account?

Yes! The plugin supports guest users through secure cookie-based storage that lasts for 30 days. When a guest user registers or logs in, their wishlist items are automatically merged with their account, ensuring no saved products are lost.

Is the plugin mobile-responsive?

Yes! All layouts, wishlist features, and admin interfaces are mobile-first and automatically optimize for tablets and smartphones. You can also customize mobile-specific settings and preview your changes on different device sizes.

Can I customize the appearance of wishlist buttons?

Absolutely! Go to ShopGlut → Wishlist Options → Appearance to customize button colors, icons, text, positioning, hover effects, and styling. You can choose from text-only, icon-only, or combined text+icon button styles.

Do customers receive notifications about their wishlist items?

Yes! Registered users can subscribe to various email notifications including stock availability alerts, price drop notifications, product updates, and low stock warnings. Users can manage their notification preferences, and all emails comply with anti-spam regulations.

Can I customize colors, fonts, and layouts?

Yes! The plugin includes comprehensive customization options for colors, typography, spacing, borders, and layouts. The Pro version adds advanced styling options including gradient backgrounds, Google Fonts integration, and custom CSS/JavaScript injection.

Does it work with my existing theme?

ShopGlut is designed to work seamlessly with any well-coded WordPress theme. The plugin integrates without conflicting with your theme’s design and includes theme compatibility checks. If you experience any styling issues, our extensive customization options can resolve them.

Is the wishlist table customizable?

Yes! You can show/hide specific columns (product image, name, price, quantity, availability, discount info, reviews, etc.), reorder columns, customize table colors and fonts, and set up sorting and filtering options.

Can I preview changes before publishing?

Yes! The single product page builder includes live preview functionality so you can see exactly how your product pages will look on desktop, tablet, and mobile before making them live. The wishlist system also includes preview options for button styling.

How do I enable social sharing for wishlists?

Social sharing is enabled by default and includes Facebook, Twitter(X), WhatsApp, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Telegram, and Email sharing options. Customers can share their wishlist with friends and family without any additional configuration required.

Can I restrict wishlist access to logged-in users only?

Yes, you can enable the “Require Login” option in ShopGlut → Wishlist Options → General Settings to restrict wishlist functionality to registered users only. You can also customize the login requirement message and button.

Do you provide customer support?

Yes! We offer free support through the WordPress.org support forums for all users. Pro users receive priority support through our dedicated support portal with faster response times and advanced troubleshooting assistance.

Can I use this plugin on multiple websites?

The free version can be used on unlimited websites. The Pro version offers different licensing options including single site, 5-site, and unlimited site licenses for agencies and developers.

How do I set up product swatches for my variations?

Navigate to ShopGlut → Product Swatches to enable and configure swatches globally. For specific attributes, go to Products → Attributes, edit your attribute, and choose the swatch type (color, image, label, or bicolor). Then edit individual attribute terms to set their colors, images, or labels. You can also override settings for individual products using the “Swatches” tab in the product editor.

Can I display swatches on shop and category pages?

Yes! Enable “Swatch Shop/Archive Page” in the Product Swatches settings. You can customize the position (before/after title or price), alignment, and choose which attributes to display. Customers can select variations directly from shop pages without visiting individual product pages.

What swatch types are supported?

ShopGlut supports four swatch types: Color swatches (solid colors), Image swatches (thumbnail images), Bicolor swatches (dual-color gradients), and Label swatches (text-based). You can mix different swatch types for different attributes on the same product.

Can I customize the appearance of swatches?

Absolutely! Control swatch dimensions, shapes (circle, square, rounded, custom), border styles, colors, and hover effects. Configure tooltips, typography, spacing, and positioning. Each attribute can have its own custom settings, and you can override global settings for individual products.

Do swatches work with out-of-stock variations?

Yes, ShopGlut intelligently handles stock status. You can choose to hide out-of-stock swatches completely or show them with disabled effects like blur, cross-out, or opacity reduction to indicate unavailability while maintaining the visual layout.

description:
ShopGlut – Builder and Customized Solutions for WooCommerce is the ultimate all-in-one solution for creating stunning WooCommerce stores. This comprehensive plugin transforms your entire WooCommerce experience with professional layouts and enhanced customer engagement features.

🔥 FIVE POWERFUL MODULES IN ONE PLUGIN

⚡ Single Product Page Builder – Create stunning, conversion-optimized product pages with drag-and-drop interface
🛒 Cart Page Builder – Design custom cart experiences with responsive layouts and interactive elements
📝 Checkout Field Editor – Add, customize, and manage checkout fields for both classic and block checkout
💝 Advanced Wishlist System – Complete wishlist solution with social sharing, notifications, and guest support
🎨 Product Swatches – Replace dropdowns with beautiful color, image, and label swatches for variations

🚀 Why Choose ShopGlut?

Transform your entire WooCommerce store from product pages to cart and checkout with our comprehensive suite of tools. Create conversion-optimized product pages, streamlined cart experiences, customized checkout forms, and advanced wishlist functionality that encourages return visits and increases sales. Our plugin offers unprecedented control over every aspect of your store design and customer journey.

🎨 COMPLETE WOOCOMMERCE STORE BUILDER SUITE

⭐ Key Benefits:
✅ Zero Coding Required – Visual sorting interface for everyone
✅ Mobile Responsive – Perfect on all devices automatically
✅ Lightning Fast – Performance-optimized for speed
✅ SEO Friendly – Built-in schema markup and optimization
✅ Theme Compatible – Works with any WordPress theme
✅ Complete Solution – Single product builder + Advanced wishlist in one plugin

🎨 SINGLE PRODUCT PAGE BUILDER

Intuitive Design Interface:
* Live Preview Demo Mode – See changes instantly as you design with real-time preview
* Product Targeting System – Overwrite all products or target specific products individually
* Template1 Configuration – Professional single product template with advanced customization
* Tabbed Settings Interface – Organized settings for Product Gallery, Info, Attributes, Purchase, Features, and Related Products
* Visual Column Builder – Create custom layouts with flexible columns
* Responsive Controls – Perfect design for mobile, tablet, and desktop

Advanced Product Gallery System:
* Main Image Controls – Customizable background, border radius, padding, and margin settings
* Thumbnail Gallery Management – Show/hide thumbnails with size, spacing, and alignment controls
* Border Customization – Independent border settings for main image and thumbnails
* Active State Styling – Custom border colors for active and hover thumbnail states
* Flexible Positioning – Left, center, or right thumbnail alignment options
* Advanced Spacing Controls – Precise margin and gap controls between gallery elements

📱 FLEXIBLE LAYOUT OPTIONS

Multiple Layout Types:
* Two Column – Classic gallery + info layout with customizable ratios
* Sidebar Layouts – Add promotional content and related products
* Mobile-First Design – Automatic mobile optimization with custom breakpoints

Column Customization:
* Custom Spacing – Control gaps between columns and sections
* Background Colors – Individual background colors for each column
* Padding Controls – Fine-tune spacing inside columns

🎨 ADVANCED PRODUCT SWATCHES SYSTEM

Comprehensive Swatch Types:
* Color Swatches – Display product variations with color swatches instead of dropdown selects
* Image Swatches – Show product variations with image thumbnails for better visual representation
* Bicolor Swatches – Advanced dual-color swatches for complex color combinations
* Label Swatches – Text-based swatches with custom styling and typography
* Mixed Attribute Types – Support for multiple swatch types within the same product

Global Swatch Management:
* Attribute-Level Control – Set swatch types globally for product attributes (color, size, material, etc.)
* Product-Level Override – Override global settings for individual products
* Term-Specific Customization – Customize individual attribute terms with specific colors, images, or labels
* Taxonomy Integration – Seamless integration with WooCommerce attribute taxonomies

Advanced Swatch Features:
* Shop Page Integration – Display swatches on shop, category, and archive pages
* Quick Selection – Allow customers to select variations directly from shop pages
* Tooltip Support – Show attribute names and details on hover
* Image Preview Tooltips – Display larger preview images for image swatches (Pro)
* Custom Positioning – Position swatches before/after title or price on shop pages
* Attribute Limiting – Limit number of swatches shown on shop pages with “more” links

Swatch Styling Options:
* Shape Controls – Circle, square, rounded, or custom dimensions
* Size Customization – Individual width and height controls for each attribute
* Border Options – Custom borders, colors, and hover effects for selected states
* Border Radius – Rounded corners with pixel-perfect control
* Typography – Font size and styling for label-type swatches
* Spacing Controls – Margin and padding adjustments for perfect alignment

Smart Swatch Behavior:
* Stock Integration – Hide or disable swatches for out-of-stock variations
* Disabled State Effects – Blur, cross-out, or hide unavailable options
* AJAX Loading – Fast, smooth swatch interactions without page reloads
* Variation Threshold – Automatic optimization for products with many variations
* Mobile Responsive – Touch-friendly swatches optimized for mobile devices

🏷️ ADVANCED PRODUCT BADGE SYSTEM

Comprehensive Badge Management:
* Six Badge Types – New, Trending, Best Seller, Hot, Sale, Limited with individual control
* Custom Badge Text – Personalize badge text for each type
* Color Customization – Independent background and text colors for each badge
* Typography Controls – Font size, weight, and spacing customization
* Global Badge Settings – Border radius, spacing, and show/hide controls
* Dynamic Badge Logic – Badges display based on product conditions and sales data

Product Information Display:
* Product Title Styling – Color, font size, and weight customization
* Rating System – Show/hide ratings with star color and text styling controls
* Price Display Controls – Current price, original price, and discount badge styling
* Description Management – Show/hide with color, font size, and line height controls
* Advanced Typography – Precise control over all text elements

Interactive Product Attributes:
* Multiple Attribute Layouts – Horizontal, vertical, and grid layout options
* Swatch Attributes – Color swatches, patterns, and image attributes with size and border controls
* Button Attributes – Text/size options displayed as styled buttons with hover effects
* Dropdown Attributes – Traditional select dropdown styling and customization
* Label Management – Show/hide attribute labels with typography controls
* Required Field Indicators – Visual asterisk styling for required attributes

🛒 ENHANCED PURCHASE SECTION

Quantity Selector Customization:
* Button Styling – Background and text color controls for plus/minus buttons
* Input Field Design – Custom background and border colors for quantity input
* Border Radius Control – Rounded corners for modern appearance
* Interactive States – Hover and focus styling for better user experience

Add to Cart Button Enhancement:
* Color Customization – Background, text, and hover color controls
* Typography Settings – Font size and weight customization
* Border Radius – Modern button styling with adjustable corners
* Button States – Active and hover state styling
* Variable Product Support – Enhanced AJAX handling for variable products

Secondary Action Buttons:
* Wishlist Integration – Show/hide wishlist button with custom styling
* Compare Functionality – Product comparison button with color controls
* Button Positioning – Flexible positioning relative to main purchase button
* Hover Effects – Custom hover colors and transitions

⭐ DYNAMIC FEATURES SECTION

Features Section Management:
* Show/Hide Control – Enable or disable the entire features section
* Custom Section Title – Personalize the features section heading
* Background Styling – Custom background colors and border radius
* Grid Layout System – Choose from 1-6 column grid layouts
* Spacing Controls – Padding and gap controls for perfect alignment

Dynamic Features List:
* Unlimited Features – Add up to 12 product features with repeater field
* Icon Options – Choose between Font Awesome icons or custom images
* Feature Titles – Custom titles for each feature with styling controls
* Feature Descriptions – Short descriptions explaining each benefit
* Optional Links – Enable links for features with target window options
* Default Features – Pre-configured features (Free Shipping, Easy Returns, Secure Payment, 24/7 Support)

Feature Styling Options:
* Alignment Control – Left, center, or right alignment for feature items
* Icon Customization – Size, color, and background controls for icons
* Typography Settings – Title and description font styling
* Link Styling – Link colors, hover effects, and decoration options
* Spacing Controls – Margins and padding for perfect layout balance

🔗 ENHANCED RELATED PRODUCTS

Related Products Section:
* Show/Hide Control – Enable or disable related products display
* Custom Section Title – Personalize the related products heading
* Products Per Row – Choose from 2, 3, or 4 products per row layout
* Section Title Styling – Custom colors and typography for section heading

Product Card Customization:
* Card Background – Custom background colors for product cards
* Border Styling – Border colors and radius for modern card design
* Hover Effects – Enable/disable card hover shadow effects
* Quick Add Buttons – Custom colors for quick add to cart buttons
* Typography Controls – Product name, price, and description styling

🛒 ADVANCED CART PAGE BUILDER

Complete Cart Page Customization:
* Visual Cart Layout Builder – Design custom cart pages with drag-and-drop interface
* Responsive Cart Tables – Mobile-optimized cart display with customizable columns
* Product Information Control – Show/hide product images, names, prices, quantities, and totals
* Interactive Elements – Custom quantity selectors, remove buttons, and continue shopping links
* Cross-sell Integration – Display recommended products and upsells in cart
* Progress Indicators – Shopping cart progress bars and checkout flow visualization
* Cart Totals Customization – Flexible subtotal, tax, shipping, and total displays

Cart Table Features:
* Customizable Headers – Configure table column headers and labels
* Product Image Settings – Control image sizes, aspect ratios, and display options
* Quantity Controls – Plus/minus buttons with validation and stock checking
* Product Meta Display – Show SKU, categories, attributes, and custom fields
* Badge System – Sale badges, stock status indicators, and promotional labels
* Action Buttons – Customizable remove, save for later, and move to wishlist buttons

Enhanced User Experience:
* AJAX Cart Updates – Real-time cart updates without page refresh
* Empty Cart States – Custom messages and call-to-action buttons for empty carts
* Cart Notifications – Success and error messages with custom styling
* Shipping Calculator – Integrated shipping cost estimation
* Coupon Code Interface – Streamlined discount code application
* Cart Recovery Features – Abandoned cart prevention and recovery tools

📝 CHECKOUT FIELD EDITOR

Complete Checkout Customization:
* Field Management System – Add, edit, remove, and reorder checkout fields
* Multiple Field Types – Text, email, phone, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, date, and more
* Section Organization – Manage billing, shipping, and additional information sections
* Advanced Validation – Email, phone, postcode, state, and number validation options
* Field Positioning – Drag-and-drop field reordering with priority controls
* Conditional Fields – Show/hide fields based on conditions and user selections

Classic Checkout Support:
* Billing Fields – Complete billing address field customization
* Shipping Fields – Flexible shipping information collection
* Additional Fields – Custom fields for order notes and special requirements
* Field Properties – Control labels, placeholders, CSS classes, and validation rules
* Required Field Settings – Mark fields as mandatory or optional
* Display Options – Choose where fields appear in emails and order details

WooCommerce Blocks Integration:
* Block Checkout Fields – Specialized fields for WooCommerce block-based checkout
* Contact Section – Custom contact information fields
* Address Section – Enhanced address field management
* Order Section – Special order-related custom fields
* Limited Field Types – Text, select, and checkbox support for blocks compatibility
* Modern Interface – Clean, modern field management interface

Advanced Features:
* Import/Export Settings – Backup and restore field configurations
* Locale Override – Override WooCommerce default locale settings
* Field Validation – Multiple validation rules for data integrity
* Order Integration – Display custom fields in admin orders and customer emails
* Database Storage – Secure storage of custom field values in order meta
* AJAX Administration – Real-time field management without page reloads

🛍️ COMPREHENSIVE WISHLIST SYSTEM

Core Wishlist Features:
* Guest User Support – Cookie-based wishlist storage with automatic login merging
* Social Sharing – Share wishlists on Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Telegram, Email
* Email Notifications – Stock alerts, price drops, and product updates for registered users
* Bulk Operations – Add all wishlist items to cart with one click

Visual Notifications:

Guest User Experience:
